items.question: In which bodily locus is the supreme absolute to be directly beheld?
premises: The wise practitioner has drawn awareness upward with the praṇava.
Awareness has been dissolved in the dvādaśānta.
The heart-lotus is specified as the locus of vision.
items.inference: Therefore, the supreme absolute is to be beheld in the heart-lotus.
uncertainties: Whether nirīkṣaṇam functions as a gerundive injunction or a nominal description is contextually inferred.
items.plain_english: And, O great goddess, in the heart-lotus there is the beholding of the supreme absolute.
